Eric Schmidt does good work


Jimmy Rushton (@JimmySecUK)

Ukraine's "Hornet" drones - supplied by Eric Schmidt's Perennial Autonomy - cost just $5000, can fly up to 200km, carry a 5kg warhead, and feature semi-autonomous targeting. 

They are already posing a severe challenge to Russian logistics which will only get worse.



— https://nitter.net/JimmySecUK/status/2057551817349697927#m
Ukraine is so militarily strong at this point that Putin is contemplating attacking NATO instead because it's a softer target.

YES. Progressives got so obsessed with the idea that Dems are wimps who never fight hard enough that they started to fight without thinking.


Matthew Yglesias (@mattyglesias)

At this point I feel like even Elizabeth Warren and her allies don’t actually know why she they want to ban new build-to-rent single family home projects, they’re just so wedded to the idea of fighting.



— https://nitter.net/mattyglesias/status/2057514560450384367#m

WL's ghost (@akanoego)

To support a claim like this, you should cite polls on support of specific aspects of progressive ideology, not the democratic party, it would be more convincing.



— https://nitter.net/akanoego/status/2057561115320562006#m

Americans really really do not like progressive ideology.

Billy Joel

(Continued)
Is that time of year when much of my diet consists of the end-of-the-year “banquets” that my kids’ various extracurricular activities throw for them.

A legend, a pioneer, and smarter and funnier than 95% of anyone to ever hold elected office. 

www.huffpost.com/entry/barney...

I feel like I became aware of Applebee’s, Chili’s, and TGI Fridays, pretty much exactly the same time in the mid 1990s. It’s looking likely that Applebee’s will be the last one standing, and I would not have guessed that.

Yes. Words that are not palindromes but they appear in a very well known palindrome sentence. That’s not hard to grasp. 

And it’s okay that you haven’t ever heard or read “Able was I ere I saw Elba.” So this is a chance to learn, not a chance to whine that other people know something you don’t.

WAITRESS: Welcome to I Love The 90s Grill and Bar! What can I getcha?
KID: I want the Macarena And Cheese!
WAITRESS: For you, ma’am?
MOM: The…Rodney King Crab?
WAITRESS: And you, sir?
DAD: The eggs.
WAITRESS: You have to say it.
DAD: *sigh* Jesus Christ. Okay. I’ll take the Sarajevos Rancheros

(That joke would work so much better if you hadn’t already used the word hog in the original Skeet — but I really can’t get upset that your post — which was not intended to be a set up for me — doesn’t work as well as as a set up for me as I would like it to)
That was created by Hog Hefner, right?
My wife’s Norwegian family love the joke “what’s one thing Sweden has that Norway doesn’t? Nice neighbors,” to which our Swedish friends say “yes, the Finns are lovely.”
It is sad. Up until now the Swedish Chef has been such an accurate depiction of Swedish culture and cuisine …

They’re opening a Swedish chef themed restaurant at Disney World. While this is welcome and long overdue, I hope there is at least some chance that my food could come to life and attack me. Otherwise, what’s the point?

www.disneytouristblog.com/new-muppets-...
One must imagine Sisyphus getting to the fireworks factory.

“Hi, Roma people. We’re really sorry that we called you that word for so long. Honestly, most of us didn’t know it was a slur. We thought it was kind of cool sounding! … no … I know. That doesn’t make it okay. It’s just … there’s this musical … it’s kind of one of the best ones …”
My 10-year-old on dinosaur chicken nuggets: They’re the best. Even if you don’t like dinos, you can just cut off the head, feet, and tails.  And then it’s like you defeated the dinosaurs.

Among the many things I find fascinating about this list is the fact that whoever assembled it put it in alphabetical order except for the last two, because apparently they thought it would be better to end with Wicked Alice rather than Wide-ass Nellie.
It’s weird, watching the Daredevil show and seeing Kingpin murder people with his bare hands and set heavily-armed maniacs against civilians, and knowing he’s still a better human being than Trump. ￼

Hey, Universe!

STOP KILLING THE WRONG OLD MEN! 

www.huffpost.com/entry/ted-tu...
Roundup #82: Staring in wonder at the world. Crime; ICE raids; AI hate; Oligarchy; AI math; Small businesses; Neoliberal Claude; Slacker AGI; The Technium
All non-drone militaries are obsolete
Dating advice for men. Don't believe the incel stuff. Romance is very possible for regular, average men.
Yes, Europeans are poorer than Americans. Comfortable, leisurely, pleasant stagnation is just not good enough for the modern age.
Trump actually started to decouple America from China. The "economic divorce" between the two countries is proceeding slowly, but it is proceeding.
Tyrants are losing wars. Ruthlessness and machismo will only get you so far in a technological world.
Do billionaires earn their money?
Barack Obama was a successful President
Could development economics be more useful?
AI's big messaging pivot. Some top AI leaders now say their technology will create jobs. Should we believe them?
California's "billionaire tax" is the wrong approach. Left-populist instincts are leading to silly policy ideas.
Roundup #81: Back to our regular programming. National debt; AI cyberattacks; Phone bans; AI and coding jobs; Millennials vs. Boomers; Public order; California YIMBYism
Scoring the Jensen-Dwarkesh debate. Export controls are holding back Chinese AI. Should we keep them?
The moderately easy problem of consciousness. Before deciding if computers are self-aware, let's figure out how humans become self-aware.
Why shoplifting is bad. It may feel like a small act of rebellion, but it hurts a lot of people who don't deserve it.
